sentences.text: Shri Sourabh Singh - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Santosh Yadav - Government Advocate for the State.
ORDER Notice to father of the victim has been served.

2. This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.963/2023 dated 01.10.2023 registered at Police Station Motinagar, District Sagar for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
3. The counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

It is contended by the counsel that the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNSS reflects that the prosecutrix and the applicant were in relationship and the prosecutrix on her own volition went with the applicant to Mumbai and stayed there for 15 months.
Thereafter they entered into wedlock and started living as husband wife under the same roof.
Thus, in such circumstances, the applicant who is in custody since 15/01/2025 be released on bail.

Per contra, counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that the offence has been committed with the minor, therefore, looking to the conduct of the applicant, no case for bail is made out.

sentences.text: 5. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

6. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and the statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS which prima facie reflects relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix who on her own volition went with the applicant to Mumbai and stayed there for a period of 15 months and thereafter entered into wedlock, thus, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
